# NewPath Online

> NewPath Online provides educational content and learning resources with comprehensive privacy protections and clear terms of service.

NewPath Online is operated by NewPath Learning, LLC, a United States-based educational organization. The site prioritizes user privacy and data security, particularly for child users, with detailed policies governing acceptable use and intellectual property rights.

## Key Topics

- privacy-policy
- data-collection
- children-privacy
- personally-identifiable-information
- user-consent
- data-security

- legal-agreement
- user-agreement

- website-terms

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Notice](https://www.newpathonline.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy for NewPath Learning covering data collection, user consent, and child privacy protections
- [Terms and Conditions of Use Agreement](https://www.newpathonline.com/terms.html): Legal terms and conditions governing website usage, intellectual property rights, and acceptable use policy
